text.content:
"Metal is Might." One of the Old Three.

Turf: Watson and the Northside Industrial District; Maelstrom collects tolls north of Eisenhower St in Little China after dark
Known for: Cyberware, heavy weapons, full-body conversions and pharmaceutical drugs
Leadership: Unknown. Chrome Mother runs the Totentanz this year
Allies & rivals: Enemies: the NCPD (C-SWAT and MaxTac above all) and the Scavengers. Patron of the Rust Choir
Hangouts: The Totentanz (#8), the dead All Foods protein plant (#9), the empty Sphere factories

The ultimate boostergang. Maelstrom began as a faction of the Metal Warriors that survived the Night City Holocaust and the Inquisitors' agitation, grew through the Time of the Red, and held on when the Purge took everyone else. It took in the Red Chrome Legion and the Iron Sights when they had nowhere else to go. It was never on the Purge List; nobody knows who protected it, and people who try to find out are hard to interview.

Joining means extensive cyberware meant to strip away the human and show the metal underneath, and the rituals have an almost occult reverence for chrome. Ex-initiates describe the initiation as brutal, ritual and cult-like. Members show their chrome on purpose, wear red optics, and etch gang marks into metal rather than skin.

For all that, Maelstrom runs a shrewd criminal empire in cybertech, black-market chrome and drugs. Its jewel is the Totentanz, which moved to Northside when the crater was cleared in 2052, and as the Co-Prosperity Sphere's plants closed in 2069–2070 Maelstrom moved into the empty shells. It clashes constantly with C-SWAT and MaxTac, and hunts Scavengers for sport.

Nobody outside knows who leads it. Every year someone claims the throne at the Totentanz, and every year the claim lasts until someone bigger shows up.

GM secrets

Doc Mags has opened up three Maelstrom initiates and found military-grade neural ware in kids who couldn't afford a sandwich. That isn't a gang budget: somebody is paying.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.25; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 04, 08
